remarks: A Bright and Inviting Apartment in Prime Stamford Location!  Step into your new home - a freshly painted, sun-filled apartment that blends comfort with modern style. The bright and spacious living room is perfect for relaxing or setting up your home office, while the dining area adjacent to the modern kitchen has a seamless space for entertaining. The kitchen boasts sleek granite countertops, abundant cabinet storage, and all essential appliances, making meal prep a breeze. A large storage closet at the entrance adds extra convenience, while the generous bedroom and fully renovated bathroom provide comfort and tranquility. Recently installed A/C units ensure you're always cool, and a brand-new glass shower door will soon enhance your bathroom experience. Located just minutes from downtown Stamford's vibrant shopping, dining, and entertainment options, you'll enjoy the best of city living with easy access to I-95, buses, and trains for commuting convenience. Key Features: *Freshly painted and move-in ready *Spacious living room with ample natural light *Modern kitchen with granite countertops and plenty of storage *Renovated bathroom and new A/C units *Close proximity to downtown Stamford, shopping, and transportation. Pet Policy: Cats allowed (limit applies), and additional costs may apply. Unfortunately, dogs are not permitted in the building.  Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to make this charming apartment your new home! Schedule your viewing today.
